Who we are

A professionally managed supplier of premium construction materials.

A&P Infra Solution is engaged in supplying premium construction materials and infrastructure solutions to builders, contractors, developers, government organisations and individual homeowners. We believe every successful project begins with quality materials and dependable service, so our team works closely with customers to get the right products at the right price, delivered on time.

Our objective is to become one of Eastern India's most trusted construction material suppliers, by maintaining the highest standards of quality, integrity and customer satisfaction.

OUR MISSION

Quality first, every delivery.

To provide premium quality construction materials and value-added solutions through ethical business practices, competitive pricing and timely delivery, while building long-term customer relationships.

OUR VISION

Trusted across India.

To become the preferred construction material supplier across India by delivering innovative solutions, exceptional service and sustainable business practices.

Eight material lines, one point of contact

From sub-base to superstructure to finishing, we stock and supply what a site needs at each stage — and coordinate delivery so your schedule doesn't wait on ours.

01

Cement Supply

Major supplier of Nuvoco, UltraTech, JK Lakshmi, Ramco and Bangur Cement, plus all leading brands — bulk and bagged, delivered to site or warehouse.

02

TMT Steel

Premium quality TMT bars for residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure construction.

03

Fly Ash

High-quality fly ash for RMC plants, brick manufacturing, cement plants and large industrial applications.

04

Construction Chemicals

Waterproofing, tile adhesives, repair mortars, grouts, epoxy systems, bonding agents, admixtures and sealants.

05

Ready Mix Concrete (RMC)

Reliable RMC supply for residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure projects, mixed to spec.

06

AAC Blocks

Lightweight, durable and energy-efficient autoclaved aerated concrete blocks for modern construction.

07

Paver Blocks

For driveways, walkways, parking areas, landscaping and industrial flooring — durable and low-maintenance.

08

Infrastructure Solutions

Coordinated material planning for larger infrastructure projects, from tendering stage through to close-out.

How an order moves

Four steps from enquiry to delivery — no layer added that doesn't need to be there.

01

Enquiry

Share your material list and site location — by call, WhatsApp or the form below.

02

Quote

We confirm grade, quantity and a delivery-ready price, usually within the same day.

03

Dispatch

Material is loaded and routed to site, with delivery confirmation sent ahead of arrival.

04

Billing

GST-compliant invoice issued on delivery, with terms agreed upfront — no follow-up chasing.
